## Item 20 — Review the coach-mark tutorial against the app as it now stands, and update it

- **Status:** PLANNED — booked 2026-07-28. **Model: Sonnet, medium effort** — a copy + coverage audit over [TutorialScript.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/tutorial/presentation/TutorialScript.kt) and a handful of `coachMarkTarget` anchors; pure presentation, follows [ADR-0034](../adr/0034-tap-to-advance-coach-mark-tutorial.md)/[ADR-0038](../adr/0038-per-module-lazy-coach-mark-tours.md) as-is. "Medium," not "low," because the anchors it audits are being moved *right now* by Items 16–18, so it must be read against the post-16/17/18 UI rather than today's. **No schema/Room/Supabase change (Room stays v31).** **Sequencing: build last in this batch — after [Item 16](#item-16--privacy-eye-becomes-a-standard-top-bar-action-recurring-manage-couple--combined-tab-renamed-spending), [Item 17](#item-17--records-header-cleanup-drop-the--overflow-reorder-to-filter--bell--eye) and [Item 18](#item-18--justify-the-module-tab-rows-equal-width-chips-edge-to-edge).**
- **Request (Alvin, 2026-07-28):** "review tutorial and update it." Taken at face value as a **two-phase item**: (A) a written drift audit of every tour against the shipped app, (B) apply the fixes. Phase B's *new* step copy needs Alvin's sign-off before it's written — he made that explicit in Item 17 ("no substitute copy… copy Alvin writes"). Phase A is unblocked and should be done first, in one pass, and shown.
- **Why now:** the script was written for the V1.6.2 IA (ADR-0038, 2026-07-05) and has had exactly one edit since — the "Combined" → "Spending" rename folded into Item 16. Everything v1.7.0 and v1.7.1 added is invisible to it, and this batch has moved the furniture the tours point at.

### Phase A — the drift already visible from a read (starting list, not the finished audit)

- **A tour is about to be orphaned into deletion.** Item 17 deletes `TutorialTours.RECORDS`, both its steps, and the `RECORDS_RECURRING` target ([TutorialScript.kt:22,94-105](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/tutorial/presentation/TutorialScript.kt#L94-L105)), leaving the app's most-used module tour-less. **Alvin already decided: no replacement** — do not reopen it here, only confirm Item 17 actually removed the constant, the `StartTourOnFirstVisit(TutorialTours.RECORDS)` call at [TransactionsScreen.kt:142](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/transactions/presentation/TransactionsScreen.kt#L142) and the `TutorialTours.RECORDS` constant itself, rather than leaving a tour id that resolves to an empty step list.
- **Three anchors move underneath their tours in this same batch, keys intact but bounds changed:** `MANAGE_TABS`/`ANALYSIS_TABS`/`COUPLE_TABS` are the three rows Item 18 justifies to full width, and `COUPLE_TABS`' host header gains an eye in Item 16. The keys survive, so nothing breaks statically — but the highlight cutout and tooltip placement change, which is a *look at it on-device* check, not a code check.
- **Nothing shipped in v1.7.0 or v1.7.1 is mentioned anywhere in the script.** Candidate surfaces, each with a note on whether it plausibly earns a step (Alvin's call, see Open questions):
  - **Calculator as a floating bubble** ([Item 14](#item-14--calculator-as-an-in-app-floating-chathead-not-a-full-screen-module) / [ADR-0058](../adr/0058-calculator-overlay-module.md)) — the strongest candidate. Tapping a navbar/More entry that *doesn't navigate* is the least discoverable interaction in the app, and it has zero explanation on any surface. Complication: Calculator isn't in `DEFAULT_PINS` ([NavDestination.kt](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/navigation/NavDestination.kt)), so on a fresh install there is no visible anchor for it — an anchor-visibility problem ADR-0038 explicitly warns about. A step inside the SHELL tour anchored to `MORE` is the only obviously-safe placement.
  - **The notification bell / inbox** ([Item 6](#item-6--notification-bell--in-app-inbox-facility)) — new on six module headers, never explained. Would need a new target on the bell inside [PlayfulScreenTitle](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/ui/PlayfulScreenTitle.kt), which is shared, so one anchor lights up on whichever module the user is standing on.
  - **The privacy eye as a header action** ([Item 16](#item-16--privacy-eye-becomes-a-standard-top-bar-action-recurring-manage-couple--combined-tab-renamed-spending)) — it now governs *globally* from any header ([[feedback-privacy-eye-is-global]]); a user who taps it on Manage and finds Records already masked has no way to know that was intended.
  - **Records' filter** (v1.7.0 Item 7), **Export in Settings** ([Item 7](#item-7--move-export-from-records-overflow-menu-to-settings)), **balance adjustment** ([Item 13](#item-13--adjust-account-balance-directly-accounts-module)), **debt-overpay cascade** ([Item 10](#item-10--allow-overpaying-a-single-debt-row-spreading-the-overflow-across-user-chosen-debts-partner-debt-tracker)), **couple photo** (v1.7.0 Item 10) — all discoverable in place; listed for completeness, weak candidates.
- **Copy to re-read line by line against the current UI**, since a tour that describes a screen wrongly is worse than no tour: RECURRING's "Switch to the calendar view" vs. the toggle Item 16 bumps left; MANAGE's "these three tabs"; ANALYSIS' "Donut / Flow / Calendar"; NOTES' three steps; TRANSACTION_ENTRY's Private-toggle copy vs. the current editor; and the five couple tours against the paired UI as it stands after Item 16's header changes.
- **Coverage map to state explicitly in the audit** — which of the nine registry modules (`RECORDS, ANALYSIS, MANAGE, COUPLE, SETTINGS, CALCULATOR, SAVINGS, NOTES, RECURRING`) have a tour after Item 17, and which don't. Today: SETTINGS has none (only `COUPLE_SETTINGS` on Personalize), CALCULATOR has none, and RECORDS is about to have none. That's the deliverable Alvin picks from.

### Phase B — the update

- Apply the copy corrections from Phase A (no sign-off needed — fixing a sentence that describes the screen wrongly is not new copy).
- Add whichever new tours/steps Alvin greenlights, with **his copy**. Each new step = one constant in [TutorialTargets](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/tutorial/presentation/TutorialScript.kt#L15), one `coachMarkTarget` on the element, one `TutorialStep` — plus, for a whole new tour, one id in [TutorialTours](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/tutorial/domain/TutorialTours.kt) and a `StartTourOnFirstVisit` call on the screen. No engine change; if a proposed step needs one, that's a separate item.
- **Explicitly unchanged:** the coach-mark engine in `core/ui`, the seen-set DataStore shape (a single `Set<String>`, so a new tour needs no migration), `PAIRED_TOURS` gating, and the "Replay tutorial" entry at [PersonalizeScreen.kt:202](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/settings/presentation/PersonalizeScreen.kt#L202).
- **Do not** turn this into a rewrite of the tutorial's *mechanism*. If the audit concludes the per-module lazy model itself is wrong, that supersedes ADR-0038 and gets booked separately.

### Open questions (resolve at build kickoff, before Phase B)

1. Does **Calculator's bubble** get a step, and where — a fourth SHELL step anchored to `MORE`, or nothing?
2. Does the **bell** get a step (needs a shared anchor in `PlayfulScreenTitle`), or is the inbox self-evident?
3. Does the **global privacy eye** get a step, given it's the one control whose effect is invisible on the screen you tap it from?
4. **Settings** has no tour at all — deliberate, or a gap now that Export and the notification settings live there?

- **Verify:** `assembleStagingDebug` + `testStagingDebugUnitTest` green, including [TutorialViewModelTest](../../app/src/test/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/tutorial/presentation/TutorialViewModelTest.kt) — it computes the "N of M" label from the pairing-filtered list, so **any** added/removed step can move an assertion; update it alongside. **Tier-1 tests otherwise not required** (script data + Composable anchors, no domain/data logic). On-device, on a paired staging account ([[test-account-credentials]], since five tours are paired-gated): **Settings → Personalize → Replay tutorial**, then walk every module in turn and confirm each tour fires once, every highlight lands on the element it describes (especially the three justified tab rows and the reordered Records/Manage/Couple headers), no tooltip points at a deleted or moved control, the "N of M" counter matches the steps actually shown, and the tour never blocks the screen behind it. Repeat the walk **unpaired** (a second account) to confirm the paired-gated tours stay unfired and `UNPAIRED_ONLY` steps still appear.

## Item 21 — Recurring becomes a two-tab module: "Recurring" (list) + "Calendar" (premium)

- **Status:** PLANNED — booked 2026-07-28. **Model: Sonnet, medium effort** — a UI restructuring over state that already exists (`RecurringViewMode`, `calendarLocked`), following the tab-row pattern three other modules already use; "medium," not "low," because it touches a **paywall-gated surface** ([`Feature.RECURRING_CALENDAR`](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/entitlement/Feature.kt#L13), individual scope, currently **dormant** per [ADR-0044](../adr/0044-entitlement-mechanism.md) / [subscription-paywall-design.md](subscription-paywall-design.md) §8.2) and deletes an element two other booked items point at. **No schema/Room/Supabase change (Room stays v31).** **Sequencing: after [Item 16](#item-16--privacy-eye-becomes-a-standard-top-bar-action-recurring-manage-couple--combined-tab-renamed-spending) and [Item 18](#item-18--justify-the-module-tab-rows-equal-width-chips-edge-to-edge); before [Item 20](#item-20--review-the-coach-mark-tutorial-against-the-app-as-it-now-stands-and-update-it).**
- **Request (Alvin, 2026-07-28):** "in recurring module, can we have 2 tabs? 1st tab is Recurring, 2nd tab is the premium Calendar View."
- **What exists today:** the calendar is not a tab — it's a **view-mode toggle**, one `IconButton` in the top bar that flips a `DateRange`/`List` glyph ([RecurringScreen.kt:126-135](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/presentation/RecurringScreen.kt#L126-L135) → `viewModel::toggleViewMode`), with the screen body a `when` on `state.viewMode` ([RecurringScreen.kt:150-194](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/presentation/RecurringScreen.kt#L150-L194)). The premium gate already exists and already works: `calendarLocked` ([RecurringUiState.kt:34](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/presentation/RecurringUiState.kt#L34)) renders the calendar as a **blurred, tap-swallowing preview with a lock + upsell** ([RecurringScreen.kt:251-275](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/presentation/RecurringScreen.kt#L251-L275)). So this item is **presentation only — it does not add, move, or change a gate.** `Feature.RECURRING_CALENDAR` already exists; nothing new goes in the paywall map.
- **Change:**
  - **Add a two-chip tab row** below the `TopAppBar`, built exactly like the three sibling rows ([CoupleScreen.kt:118-131](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/couple/presentation/CoupleScreen.kt#L118-L131) is the closest — also two chips): a `fillMaxWidth` `Row`, 22dp horizontal padding, `Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)`, two [PlayfulChip](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/core/ui/PlayfulChip.kt)s labelled **"Recurring"** and **"Calendar"**, each `Modifier.weight(1f)` — **born justified**, per Item 18, rather than shipping a fourth row that then needs the same fix.
  - **Delete the top-bar toggle `IconButton`** and rename `toggleViewMode()` → `selectViewMode(RecurringViewMode)` in [RecurringViewModel.kt:216](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/presentation/RecurringViewModel.kt#L216). Two affordances for one choice is worse than either alone — do not keep the icon "for power users." `PrivacyEyeAction()` ([Item 16](#item-16--privacy-eye-becomes-a-standard-top-bar-action-recurring-manage-couple--combined-tab-renamed-spending)) then becomes the *only* top-bar action, which is fine — Item 16's "bump the calendar toggle left" simply stops applying once the toggle is gone.
  - **Keep the body as a `when` on `state.viewMode` — no `HorizontalPager`**, deliberately unlike Couple/Analysis/Manage. Reason: the ViewModel only computes `firingsByDay` when `viewMode == CALENDAR` ([RecurringViewModel.kt:84](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/presentation/RecurringViewModel.kt#L84)), and a pager pre-composes the adjacent page — which would force that computation always-on or flash an empty calendar mid-swipe. The cost is losing swipe-to-switch on a two-tab screen where both chips are always on-screen. **If Alvin wants swipe parity with the other modules, that's a follow-up item, not a silent addition here.**
  - **Keep the FAB list-only** ([RecurringScreen.kt:141](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/presentation/RecurringScreen.kt#L141)) — there's nothing to add from the calendar.
  - **The "premium" marking on the Calendar chip — recommended: drive it off `state.calendarLocked`, don't hard-code it.** A small lock glyph (or "Calendar 🔒") renders **only when `calendarLocked` is true**, i.e. enforcement ON *and* no premium. That's the dormant-correct choice: today the badge is invisible (kill-switch OFF → `calendarLocked` is always false → the tab looks like any other), and it appears by itself the day enforcement flips, with no second edit. Hard-coding a permanent lock badge would advertise a paywall that isn't live and would wrongly stay lit for a **premium** user after it is. `PlayfulChip` takes no trailing-content slot today, so this is either a small slot addition to the component or a label suffix — prefer the label suffix unless it looks wrong on-device.
  - **Never gate the tab *switch* itself.** A locked user taps "Calendar" and lands on the existing blurred preview + upsell — that preview *is* the sell (§8.2). A chip that refuses to select would remove the upsell surface entirely.
  - **Explicitly unchanged:** the entitlement plumbing (`premiumGate.observeLocked()`, `onCalendarLockedTap()`, the paywall entry source string), `RecurringCalendarChart`, the month stepper, the editor dialog, the rule list, the plain `TopAppBar` (Recurring keeps it — **not** converted to `PlayfulScreenTitle`, which would hand it a notification bell and reopen [Item 6](#item-6--notification-bell--in-app-inbox-facility)'s accepted six-module boundary).
- **Consequence to hand to [Item 20](#item-20--review-the-coach-mark-tutorial-against-the-app-as-it-now-stands-and-update-it), not to skip:** the deleted `IconButton` carries `coachMarkTarget(TutorialTargets.RECURRING_CALENDAR)` ([RecurringScreen.kt:128](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/recurring/presentation/RecurringScreen.kt#L128)), and the `TutorialTours.RECURRING` tour's first step is anchored to it with the copy *"Switch to the calendar view to see every recurring rule laid out by date."* ([TutorialScript.kt:107-112](../../app/src/main/java/com/iponlove/app/feature/tutorial/presentation/TutorialScript.kt#L107-L112)). **Unlike [Item 17](#item-17--records-header-cleanup-drop-the--overflow-reorder-to-filter--bell--eye)'s orphaned RECORDS tour, this one has an obvious re-home:** move the anchor onto the new tab row, exactly as `MANAGE_TABS`/`ANALYSIS_TABS`/`COUPLE_TABS` anchor theirs. Do that move **in this slice** (it's a one-line modifier relocation, and leaving a dangling anchor between two items is how orphans survive); leave the *copy* revision ("view" → "tab") to Item 20's audit, which is already reading that tour.
- **Verify:** `assembleStagingDebug` + `testStagingDebugUnitTest` green. **Tier-1 tests not required** — no domain/data/money logic; the ViewModel change is a rename plus setting an enum, and the gate it reads is already covered. On-device (no paired account needed — `RECURRING_CALENDAR` is **individual** scope): the tab row sits flush edge-to-edge with two equal-width chips matching Manage/Analysis/Couple; tapping **Calendar** shows the month grid and the FAB disappears; tapping **Recurring** brings back the list and the FAB; the old top-bar toggle icon is **gone** and the eye is the only action left; the eye still masks rule amounts from the new layout; month stepping and day selection still work on the Calendar tab; the RECURRING first-visit tour (fresh install or **Settings → Personalize → Replay tutorial**) highlights the **tab row**, not a missing icon, and doesn't crash. **Then verify the dormant gate both ways** — with the entitlement kill-switch still OFF the Calendar chip shows **no** lock badge and the calendar renders unblurred; flip enforcement on locally (however S9's kill-switch is exercised) and confirm the chip gains its lock, the tab still selects, and the blurred preview + upsell tap still opens the paywall with the same source string as before.
